newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar off highs in PM despite firm NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar off highs in PM despite firm NY.

text.p: LIFFE sugar failed to repeat earlier highs in afternoon trade, despite a firmer New York, traders said.
August hit a high of $323 during the morning and then eased and has so far failed to repeat the performance, traders said.
By 1535 GMT August was $1.20 higher at $322.40, on volume of 500 lots, out of a total of 1,378, making it the most active month.
There was enough selling to take the steam out of any attempt by the market to rally, one trader said.
"London's a bit of a damp squib," he said. "But there is some selling around all the time."
The market would struggle to get higher without any new fundamental news, he said.
London failed to respond to an early rally in New York, as US traders followed through on Monday's higher close.

Brazil's key port of Santos was partially paralyzed by an indefinite strike involving a group of administrative workers which began at 0100 local/0400 GMT today, a CODESP port authority spokesman said.
Some 23 ships docked in CODESP berths have been hit by the strike, including eight ships loading bagged sugar and one loading bulk sugar, CODESP said.
